easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
